narration.text: Nineteen sixty-nine. A black arrow heads for China. No pilot. Only a camera and a stored route.

sentences.text: Nineteen sixty-nine.
A black arrow heads for China.
No pilot.
Only a camera and a stored route.

narration.text: The D-twenty-one. Built by Lockheed for the CIA. A B-fifty-two carried it up. A rocket booster pushed it past Mach three.

sentences.text: The D-twenty-one.
Built by Lockheed for the CIA.
A B-fifty-two carried it up.
A rocket booster pushed it past Mach three.

narration.text: Target: Lop Nor, China's nuclear test site. It flew the route alone. No joystick. No second chances.

sentences.text: Target: Lop Nor, China's nuclear test site.
It flew the route alone.
No joystick.
No second chances.

narration.text: After photographing the site, it turned for the Pacific. The film sat inside a small recovery pod.

sentences.text: After photographing the site, it turned for the Pacific.
The film sat inside a small recovery pod.

narration.text: Over the ocean, the pod ejected. A parachute opened, and a C-one-thirty moved in to catch it. The drone itself was expendable.

sentences.text: Over the ocean, the pod ejected.
A parachute opened, and a C-one-thirty moved in to catch it.
The drone itself was expendable.
That was the plan.

narration.text: The first drone missed its turn.

sentences.text: The first drone missed its turn.

narration.text: The second returned, but its parachute failed.

sentences.text: The second returned, but its parachute failed.

narration.text: On the third, the pod was lost at sea.

sentences.text: On the third, the pod was lost at sea.
The fourth crashed inside China.

narration.text: Four missions. No usable pictures. In nineteen seventy-one, the program was shut down.

sentences.text: Four missions.
No usable pictures.
In nineteen seventy-one, the program was shut down.

narration.text: But one wreck survived. Decades later, China put a D-twenty-one on display: a secret mission, hiding in plain sight.

sentences.text: But one wreck survived.

sfx.desc: pylon release: hook creak, steel clunk, ejector ram, wing flex, drone falling away
solid booster: ignition thump, crackling roar (deep, 40-300 Hz weighted), burnout into cruise
heavy focal-plane shutter, body knock, film advance
optical window shutter closing: blades, servo whine, latch
small control actuator for 'turned for the Pacific'
recovery pod: squib/pressure pop, hatch ring, gas hiss, tumbling away
parachute: pilot snap, line pay-out, canopy whump, fabric flutter
C-130: four props beating, rising roar, turbine whine, gentle Doppler
mid-air retrieval: cable zip, hook contact, tension thump, line twang, winch
hard contactor throw; everything else (air, effects, tails) is gated to silence 36.0-38.0
guidance fault: servo hunting, fault relay + end-stop, gyro rotor spinning down
parachute failure: weak pop, canopy rip, line snap, ragged flutter, whistle of a fast fall
sea impact: slap, cavity bloop, spray, bubbles, then muffled as the pod goes under
low restrained crash: deep thud, dirt, scattered debris (no explosion)
blank film transport: motor, sprocket ticks, tail flapping, spool stop
soft breaker drop under 'the program was shut down'
CRT degauss thump + decaying mains hum as the archive terminal wakes
steel archive drawer rolls shut: heavy stop, ring, latch, rebound

silence_gate.note: air, effects and tails are muted; relay_hard, keys and voice are not
